title.narrative: Moldova Inclusive and Participatory Political Processes (MIPPP)

description.narrative: (Moldova): .Moldova Inclusive and Participatory Political Processes (MIPPP) works with political parties, national party leaders and emerging political actors, local government officials, civil society organizations (CSOs) and citizen activists to ensure fairer and more transparent political competition in Moldova. MIPPP focuses on three key areas: promoting more inclusive and accountable political parties at the national level; supporting emerging parties and underrepresented groups; and enhancing party and government officials' representation of citizens. MIPPP uses consultations, guided practice, leadership training, forums and coordinated public opinion research to strengthen political parties' internal capacity and outreach to citizens, and develop emerging political leaders and citizens' ability to monitor and advocate for reforms. This activity also supports .Funds from the new elections observations activity have been re-allocated to an extension of the current MIPPP activity in order to provide flexible, responsive assistance. MIPPP will continue to help political parties and political leaders at the national level respond to citizen interests. MIPPP will assist parties to increase financial transparency, thereby countering malign influence in electoral processes. Focus areas will include: increased opportunity for youth to improve their political and leadership skills; and support underrepresented groups. In addition, backing will be provided for political parties to improve outreach and communication with citizens on local issues. Locally elected officials will also learn to share good governance practices and strengthen their relations with peers in other regions. This activity supports JRS goal #4, Uphold Western Democratic Principles and Institutions, and sub-goal 4.1 to strengthen democratic institutions and rule of law. This activity also supports (100%) CAATSA goal #4. . ..
